title: Inspect and document IMS bearing condition and shaft play

notices.text: Before the bearing comes out, feel for radial and axial play at the shaft nose. Any detectable play, any roughness on rotation, or a collapsed/missing seal on the outer race means the bearing has been shedding into the oil — which changes the whole build, because that debris has been through every bearing in the engine. Capture the state of the grease: a dry, brown, varnished bearing is the textbook pre-failure condition. Photograph the balls and both races.
